heading: What every Cedar Mill Plumbing job comes with.
subtext: Whether it's a $189 drain cleaning or a $12,000 repipe — the standards are the same.
cardLead: Every job, every visit, every invoice. No tier system, no "premium service" upsell.
benefits: Written quote before any work starts on projects $500+, flat-rate on common service calls
Same plumber every visit — Mike Hollister, no rotating techs or subcontractors
Drop cloths and shoe covers on every visit. Cleaned-up worksite at completion
Photos of every job sent with the invoice — joints, runs, fittings, before and after
Permits pulled and inspections scheduled where required, included in the written quote
1-year workmanship warranty on standard work, 5-year on whole-house repipes, manufacturer warranty pass-through on parts
note: Licensed Oregon plumber, Oregon CCB # (placeholder), bonded and insured. Service area: Cedar Mill, Bethany, Beaverton, Hillsboro, and NW Portland (97225, 97229, 97006, 97005, 97124, 97210, 97231). 24/7 emergency dispatch inside the service area; non-emergency work typically scheduled inside 3 to 5 business days.
